name: WayriCAD Manufacturing Readiness Manager
description: Audit fabricator capabilities and gate deterministic KiCad manufacturing releases.
description_full: Combines reusable fabricator capability profiles with board geometry audits, KiCad JSON DRC and jobset execution, explicit pass/fail release gates, and ZIP packaging with SHA-256 file manifests. It does not claim fabricator acceptance; profiles must be reviewed against the current fabrication quotation.
